messages:
maria: Quick sync — pricing/packaging rollout dependencies. Need clarity on three items before we freeze the rollout for next week: 1) metering adapter compatibility with multi-tenant tenants, 2) quota contract edge-cases for reserved capacity, and 3) billing integration for plan-level rate card changes. Can owners ack and list current blockers? @derek @alex @sam :eyes:

Derek: Ack, I'm on metering. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/312 — code review requested from @alex. Main blocker: changes to the consumption event schema; impacts downstream billing pipeline. ETA for merge if review done: EOD Thu.

alex: Reviewing now. Two notes: (a) billing pipeline's transform expects `usage.unit` = "token" — the PR introduces `usage.metric` which needs a mapping layer; (b) contract team flagged that per-contract `max_qps` must be enforced at the proxy layer for Dedicated customers. I'll open a small adaptor PR for the mapping. 

sam: From packaging side: we need to define behaviour for quota enforcement when customers have Reserved Capacity + burst. Currently our quota calcs exclude reserved pool uses, which confuses billing. Proposed: add `reserved` flag in usage events and have billing treat it as pre-paid. Is that acceptable to billing? @alex @derek

alex: That's reasonable, but we'll need a clear schema. Suggest using this pattern:
``n{"customer_id": "c123", "usage": {"metric":"tokens","amount": 1200, "reserved": true}}
```
I'll add to the adapter PR.

maria: Good. Can we capture a short checklist so PMs can decide gating? Suggest items:
- [ ] metering adapter merged + integration test green
- [ ] billing transform mapping added + staging deploy
- [ ] quota enforcement documented & proxy patch rolled
- [ ] contract exceptions matrix updated
Please add owners + ETA in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/pricing-rollout

Derek: I'll add tests and link to them in the PR by tomorrow morning. Note: may need a small migration to re-tag historical events with `reserved=false` if we change schema — low risk but FYI.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline: nightly run scheduled 2026-09-02T02:00Z. Current staging transform version: v1.14.0. :gear:

maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits an unexpected blocker, ping this thread. Will do a quick async check-in Wed 10:00 PT. :calendar:
